age.evidence: Experiments were outperformed on adult male Wistar rats (SPF, Velaz s.r.o., Prague, Czechia). The animals weighed 280 -300 g at the time of surgery, and 300 -350 g at the time of registration.

sex.evidence: adult male Wistar rats ... 10 rats for saline, nine rats for LSD, eight for psilocin, 12 for mescaline, and 11 for DOB were selected for signal analysis

dosing.doses_raw: psilocin (4 mg/kg dissolved in 2 ml of saline (0.9% NaCl), acidified with 10 μl of glacial acetic acid)
dosing.evidence: psilocin (4 mg/kg dissolved in 2 ml of saline (0.9% NaCl), acidified with 10 μl of glacial acetic acid) ... All of the substances were administered subcutaneously in a dose of 2 ml/kg of animal weight. ... Each rat was recorded only once.

dosing.doses_raw: LSD (in a form of freebase, 0.2 mg/kg dissolved in 20 μl of 96% ethanol and then adjusted to the required volume of 5 ml by saline (0.9% NaCl w/v)
dosing.evidence: LSD (in a form of freebase, 0.2 mg/kg dissolved in 20 μl of 96% ethanol and then adjusted to the required volume of 5 ml by saline (0.9% NaCl w/v) ... All of the substances were administered subcutaneously

mescaline hydrochloride (100 mg/kg) ... All of the substances were administered subcutaneously in a dose of 2 ml/kg of animal weight. Saline (0.9% NaCl w/v) was used as a placebo in the control group.
2,5-dimethoxy-4-bromoamphetamine (DOB, 5 mg/kg) ... All of the substances were administered subcutaneously in a dose of 2 ml/kg of animal weight.

handling.evidence: No pre-test handling protocol described; only: 'The animals were handled for a few seconds if a suspicion of sleep was observed' during recording.

group_housing.evidence: Rats were kept in pairs in standard plastic breeding containers ... After the surgery, the rats were individually separated (to prevent biting of the implant) until the day of registration.

day_night_flipped.evidence: regular twelve-hour (6:00 -18:00) light/dark cycle ... The experiments were conducted during the daytime, between 7:30 and 13:00

enrichment_housing.evidence: Rats were kept in pairs in standard plastic breeding containers; home-cage enrichment not mentioned.

judge_notes: The study is an EEG (pharmaco-EEG power spectra and coherence) study; EEG is a neural recording and is excluded by the rubric.

Two of three candidates (qwen, deepseek4) scored no behavioural assays. gemma4 proposed 'Behavioral Activity Scoring' (active/inactive ratio). This was dropped because the observer scoring of active vs inactive states served mainly to select resting-state-like EEG segments. It is a state annotation for the neural recording, not a behavioural test whose primary outcome is behaviour. The activity ratio was reported briefly, with no significant drug vs control post hoc effects.

group_housing set to 'no': rats were pair-housed initially but were individually housed after surgery through the day of registration. Recording took place in their home cages while they were single-housed.
LSD vehicle set to 'ethanol' because the rubric says to use the first-listed solvent of a mix; LSD was dissolved in ethanol and then diluted with saline.
Mescaline and DOB vehicles set to 'not_reported'. The paper names saline only as the placebo and as the psilocin and LSD diluent; it never states the solvent for these two drugs.
n_male = 50 is the number of animals analysed. Groups of 12 were operated, giving 60 implanted rats.
The DOI is taken from the paper text (Translational Psychiatry (2021) 11:506).
